Upload: A controller class responsible for handling file uploads in the OpenCart platform. It manages file validation, sanitization, storage, and communicates success or error messages via JSON responses.

classes.name: Upload
classes.description: This class handles the file upload process, including validation of upload token, filename, file type, mime type, saving the file, and returning JSON responses.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method handling file upload requests. Validates upload token, checks the uploaded file, sanitizes filename, validates file type and mime, moves the uploaded file, saves upload record, and returns JSON response.
